title: Atman Devasya

hook.text: A shadow which helps to guide light to the lost.

chapters.recap: 2189. Shan Zhuang came for the Artifact. Raj Vetramani died defending Delhi, and Veraya Pillai went over a cliff into the Satvati with the Artifact in her hands.

hook.text: I just felt as if something spoke within me to be cautious.

chapters.recap: Abhimanyu turned 24 and learned his time dilator might finally get neutronium. That night he fought a dozen men in an alley over a stray pup. Off the Horn of Africa, a golden eagle dived at Titanus Spewah.

author.name: Atharva Nandkishor Pawar
lines: I'm a student of Smolensk State Medical University studying medicine.
Fantasy has always been my genre and I wanted to create something truly of my own.
Thanks to my friends and family alike, I could finally complete this cherished wish.
I dedicate this novel and its immense success to every well-wisher alike.
author.why: I present to everyone a world where they will learn how to trust themselves and others... and how they can relate to superheroes who live in a book and yet are so alike them.

home.coldOpen: I guess I never wanted to be a hero…

lines.text: I felt a power surge over the east, approximately 35°11′57″. We have to be sure, I will just repor…
The huge blast tore open the control room's western wall.
This junk only has fancy covering.
It's no coincidence that a titan had it in possession.
Hand it over, or see your beloved city turned to mere dust.
We were kids when the capital was rubbled by Shan Zhuang.
A dead astral attracts attention. And that name has been forbidden for a decade.
…but he wants to wash dishes and cook in a 3rd rated restaurant where barely ghosts come to eat.
He was just looking, as if the weapon just called him.
